description: This file defines a custom tensor subclass 'ExpandedWeight' for handling expanded weight tensors in RNNs, including context managers for batch configuration, and functions for handling per-sample gradients in PyTorch. It also manages decomposition tables for RNN operations.

classes.name: ExpandedWeight
classes.description: A subclass of torch.Tensor that handles expanded weights for RNNs, supporting per-sample gradients and custom behavior for specific functions.

methods.name: __new__
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ExpandedWeight, ensuring the original tensor is suitable.

methods.name: __torch_function__
methods.description: Overrides torch's __torch_function__ to handle specific functions with decomposition and custom logic.

methods.name: set_allow_smaller_batches
methods.description: Sets whether smaller batches are allowed for this weight.

methods.name: set_batch_first
methods.description: Sets whether the batch dimension is first.
